skills.name: ask-secrets
skills.description: Ask the person for API keys, tokens, passwords, connection strings and other private values through the query CLI, which opens a small prompt on their Mac, instead of asking them to paste the value into chat. Use whenever a task needs a credential or environment variable you don't have, such as a missing API key, a command failing on an unset variable, a .env file that needs a value, or a test that needs live credentials.
